title: Upscale crosshatch on skin and cloth: seen on Qwen-Image 2.1 upscale, traced to 4x-NMKD-Siax
description: MPI-936 bench run 3 (2026-10-08): the Qwen 2.1 upscale op (1.5x, 0.3 denoise) leaves a fine diagonal crosshatch on skin and cloth. probe_siax_only ran 4x-NMKD-Siax ALONE (no Qwen, scaled to 1.5x) and the pattern was already there; the 2.1 VAE round-trip keeps it, 0.45 denoise only softens it (tasks/MPI-936/research/bench-results.md run 3). Siax is defaultUpscale on every photo model (js/data/modelConstants/models.js), so Klein/Krea2/SDXL upscales likely carry it too. Fabio 2026-10-10 asked whether it is Siax or the Qwen upscale: re-confirm side by side (Siax-only vs Qwen upscale vs another upscaler) before swapping the default. Start with Qwen 2.1. Umbrella MPI-1064.
